info.title: Ricky API
info.description: REST API for one Ricky organization: contacts, conversations, messages, templates, broadcasts, workflows and webhooks. Requests and responses are JSON with snake_case fields; IDs are UUIDs except template IDs; times are ISO 8601 in UTC.

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: People in the CRM and their custom fields.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: Threads with a contact on one channel: start, read, assign, close, reopen.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Read and send messages, and follow each send.

tags.name: Broadcasts
tags.description: One WhatsApp template to many numbers, now or scheduled, and each delivery.

tags.name: Catalogs
tags.description: Channels, members and tags to reference by ID.

tags.name: Quick replies
tags.description: Saved answers operators insert into a message.

tags.name: WhatsApp
tags.description: Message templates and their Meta review, and the status, quality and limits of each number.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Subscriptions Ricky posts events to, and their deliveries.

tags.name: Workflows
tags.description: Automations that answer, ask, wait and assign when a conversation opens.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: The numbers of the Reports pages, for a period and the same filters.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: AI agents that answer conversations, and the options to configure them.

tags.name: Knowledge
tags.description: Locations, directory contacts and files the agents consult and share.
